fullContentHtml:
DUVASU Mathura PVT Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : UP Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Pashu Chikitsa, Mathura (DUVASU) has released the result for the UG | PG | Ph.D & Diploma Courses online application for admission 2026 on the official website of the DUVASU. Applications for the DUVASU Mathura PVT Online Form 2026 were accepted from 15 February 2026, to 22 April 2026. The written examination was held on 17 May 2026 & 07 and 21 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their DUVASU Mathura PVT Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 February 2026
  • Last Date : 22 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 April 2026
  • UGEE Exam Date : 17 May 2026
  • DEE Exam Date : 07 June 2026
  • PGEE Exam Date : 21 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 15 May 2026
  • Result Declared : 22 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 2000/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
